name: Groundwater, Water Table, Springs & Aquifer Recharge Runtime
design_rules: groundwater recharge derives from infiltration rather than direct rainfall alone
water table rises and falls gradually according to aquifer storage
springs activate when water table exceeds aquifer-specific thresholds
baseflow can sustain streams and wetlands after rainfall stops
North Woodland retains groundwater contribution longer than Ring Basin
clay lenses recharge slowly and may perch local water tables
groundwater state persists across world days
groundwater never uses emissive or glow feedback
